~~I tested this with the current git version. Using cython 0.16, the problem goes away.~~

~~Broken:~~

```
sudo make clean && sudo python2 setup.py install
```

~~Fixed:~~

```
sudo make clean && make cython && sudo python2 setup.py install
```
